steps.en: Amount rejections reach PLUS only as a generic error
steps.id: Penolakan jumlah sampai ke PLUS hanya sebagai error umum
steps.why_en: PLUS gets a generic 'Invalid format' message, not a reason saying the requested amount cannot be allowed.
steps.why_id: PLUS hanya menerima pesan umum 'Invalid format', bukan alasan bahwa jumlah yang diminta tidak dapat diizinkan.

steps.en: PLUS is told when a notice does not qualify
steps.id: PLUS diberi tahu bila notice tidak memenuhi syarat

steps.en: PLUS is told when the notice is already paid
steps.id: PLUS diberi tahu bila notice sudah dibayar

steps.en: The error is returned to PLUS and nothing is changed
steps.id: Error dikembalikan ke PLUS dan tidak ada data berubah
